project_info.theme: Shopee loyalty half-year recap reward poster
project_info.color_palette: Shopee orange, bright yellow, royal blue, white, gold

main_subject.detail: A cheerful mascot poster for Yves Rocher France loyalty customers. Top branding includes the Shopee logo, 'YVES ROCHER FRANCE', and a red badge 'KHACH HANG THAN THIET'. Main headline reads 'TONG KET 6 THANG DAU NAM CUNG SHOPEE'. A central blue banner with date tabs '10.07' and '19.07' says 'NHAN NGAY 100.000D'. Fine print below mentions ranking tiers and hashtag '#thanghangshopee2026'. Two cute chibi fire-like mascots stand at the bottom, one holding a golden trophy and the other carrying Shopee shopping bags. Floating reward tickets and gift boxes surround them.
main_subject.style: Bright playful mascot advertising poster with toy-like character rendering and oversized reward typography
